title: Chef's Workbench
description: Build a functional Minecraft kitchen to cook, fry, bake, steam, and boil food with specialized cooking stations.
body:
Chef's Workbench

Turn your Minecraft kitchen into a working place to cook, fry, bake, steam, and boil food.


## Build Your Kitchen - **Stove:** Uses fuel to cook food and can produce a bonus byproduct. - **Pan:** Place it directly on top of a stove to fry up to four ingredients. - **Pot:** Combine up to six ingredients into one cooked dish. - **Oven:** Bake food in eight separate cooking slots. - **Bamboo Steamer:** Steam food in four separate cooking slots. - **Counter:** Complete your kitchen with a matching preparation surface.

The stove supplies heat to the pan placed above it. Keep fuel in the stove, then use the pan to cook either separate ingredients or a combined recipe. ## Cooking Stations [_How to Add Custom Recipes_](https://github.com/TamKungZ/ChefWorkbench-MinecraftMod/blob/main/DATAPACK_RECIPES.md) ### Stove Use the stove as the main heat source for your kitchen. Add fuel, place cookware nearby, and start cooking.

### Pot Combine multiple ingredients together to boil hearty meals and cooked dishes.

### Pan Place the pan above a stove to fry ingredients or prepare pan-based recipes.

### Bamboo Steamer Steam food in separate slots for a cleaner and lighter cooking style.

### Oven Bake multiple foods at once using eight separate cooking slots.

## Supported Versions | Minecraft | Mod loaders | | --- | --- | | 1.20.1 | Forge, Fabric | | 1.21.1 | Forge, Fabric, NeoForge | | 1.21.11 | Fabric, NeoForge | | 26.1.2 | Fabric, NeoForge | Always use the download made for your exact Minecraft version and loader. ## Recipe Viewers - **Minecraft 1.20.1:** JEI, EMI, and REI on Forge and Fabric - **Minecraft 1.21.1:** JEI on Forge - **Minecraft 1.21.1:** JEI, EMI, and REI on Fabric and NeoForge - **Minecraft 1.21.11:** JEI and REI on Fabric and NeoForge - **Minecraft 26.1.2:** JEI on Fabric and NeoForge Recipe viewers are optional. Chef's Workbench works without one, but installing one makes discovering every cooking recipe much easier. ## Install 1. Download the file that matches your Minecraft version and mod loader. 2. Place the downloaded `.jar` file in your `mods` folder. 3. Start Minecraft and look for the **Chef's Workbench** creative tab. 4. Craft a **Stove**, add fuel, and begin building your kitchen. Install **JEI**, **EMI**, or **REI** to browse recipes in-game. ## Need Help? Found a bug or have an idea? Report it on the [Chef's Workbench issue tracker](https://github.com/TamKungZ/ChefWorkbench-MinecraftMod/issues).
